missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Движение' is the neuter nominative subject, here meaning traffic. 'Быстрое' is the agreeing neuter adjective. A clean model for everyday city language.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. Neuter 'движение' has an accusative identical to the nominative, here the direct object of 'развивает'. 'Тела' is the genitive of belonging. A useful physical pattern.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Движения' is the genitive required by 'нет'. 'Совсем' intensifies the negation. A core negation pattern for stillness.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Движению' is the dative governed by 'радуются'. 'Любому' agrees in the neuter dative. A lively emotional-reaction model.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with preposition. 'За движением' uses the instrumental 'движением' after 'за', governed by 'следить'. 'Вокруг' adds the scope. A useful monitoring pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В этом движении' uses the prepositional 'движении' after 'в' to locate a quality. 'Много энергии' uses the genitive of quantity. A reflective pattern.

Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В общественном движении' uses the prepositional 'движении' after 'в', here meaning a social movement. 'Общественном' agrees in the neuter prepositional. Useful civic vocabulary.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Движения' is the accusative plural, the direct object of 'повторял'. 'Плавные' agrees in the plural. A vivid model for describing motion.

Strategic focus: Accusative in idiom. 'В движение' uses the accusative 'движение' after 'в' in the set phrase 'прийти в движение', to start moving. 'Медленно' adds the manner. A useful fixed expression.
Strategic focus: Genitive with preposition. 'Без движения' uses the genitive 'движения' after 'без' to express absence of activity. 'Мышцы' is the nominative plural subject. A strong health pattern.
